persona: Embedded validation engineer testing peripheral controllers on a new SoC
resumeText:
Kavya Reddy | Hyderabad | kavya.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Embedded Validation Engineer, Golconda Semitech, Hyderabad (2020 - present)
- Run post-silicon validation of I2C, SPI and UART controllers on a new IoT SoC.
- Write C test cases that program controller registers and check interrupts.
- Automate overnight regression runs with Python scripts and a lab power controller.
- Debug hangs with JTAG and capture bus timing on an oscilloscope and logic analyzer.
- Bring up boards on Linux and read kernel logs to triage driver failures.

SKILLS
C, Python, Linux, JTAG, Perl

EDUCATION
BTech Electronics and Communication, JNTU Hyderabad, 2020
